title: Hangfire
description: An open-source framework for performing background job processing in .NET applications.

data.text: Hangfire is an open-source framework that helps you create, process, and manage background jobs. It supports fire-and-forget, delayed, recurring, and continuation jobs with persistent storage.

data.title: Installation
data.content: Install Hangfire and a storage provider.
data.code:
dotnet add package Hangfire
dotnet add package Hangfire.SqlServer

data.title: Configuring Hangfire
data.content: Set up Hangfire in ASP.NET Core.

terms.definition: A job executed once as soon as possible.
A job that runs on a specified schedule (e.g., Cron).
A web UI for monitoring and managing background jobs.

data.title: Dashboard
data.text: Enable the Hangfire Dashboard at `/hangfire` to monitor job execution and retries.

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: Hangfire is a comprehensive solution for background job processing in .NET.
